item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 22/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually today and tomorrow. The weather will improve over the region. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be hot during the day.

Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 25 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
